title: returns-warranty.rma
description: A snapshot of an RMA, a Customer's request to return units of a Variant from a delivered Order or to claim their warranty, published when it is requested and with each step of its lifecycle after. Keyed by rmaId.

eventId.description: Unique per event; the same event delivered twice has the same eventId.

occurredAt.description: When the change was published, in the transaction that made it.

rmaId.description: The RMA's ID: the message key.

version.description: The RMA's version, which goes up by one with every change. Apply an event only if it is newer than what you hold.

change.description: Why the event was published: REQUESTED for a new RMA, the status a step moved it to, or BACKFILLED when an RMA from before Sprint 6 had its Warehouse or Refund amount filled in, which is no step.

reference.description: The RMA reference: RMA- and the first eight characters of its ID, upper-cased.

productName.description: The Product's name, as it was shipped.

serialNumbers.description: One per unit for a serial-tracked Variant, as shipped; empty for any other.

window.description: The window the request was checked against, kept as it was then.

warranty.description: The Warranty terms a Warranty Window was worked out from; left out for a Return Period.

refundAmount.description: What refunding its units gives back: their Prices less their share of the Order's Discounts, plus their share of its Tax; never the Shipping cost. Left out of an RMA requested before Returns & Warranty projected its Order, until it has.

amountMinor.description: The amount in its Currency's Minor unit.

sendBackBy.description: The Send-back deadline: by when its units must be received, the later of its window's end and the Send-back period after its approval. Left out until it is approved.

warehouseId.description: The Warehouse its units go back to, such as WH-BER: the one its Shipment came from. Left out until it is approved, and while that isn't known.

inspection.description: Staff's Inspection of its received units; left out until it is inspected.

outcome.description: ACCEPTED or REFUSED for a RETURN; FAULT_CONFIRMED or NO_FAULT_FOUND for a WARRANTY_CLAIM.

note.description: Always given for REFUSED and NO_FAULT_FOUND.

resolution.description: What resolved it; left out until it is REFUNDED, EXCHANGED or CLOSED. A CLOSED RMA's is empty.

paymentTransactionReference.description: The Refund's Payment transaction reference, when REFUNDED.

decisions.description: The RMA history, oldest first: every step, who took it and when. It keeps the name it had when it held only RMA decisions. An RMA requested before Sprint 6 starts with its RMA decision, an RMA requested since with its request.

decidedBy.description: Who took the step: CUSTOMER for the request, a Staff member's ID for a decision, receipt or Inspection, or ORCHESTRATION for the returns Saga's.

note.description: The step's note, left out when it has none: an approval's, a rejection's reason, an Inspection's note, a resolution's or a hold's reason.
